description: Per-disclosure feed of politician trades: one item per congressional STOCK Act periodic transaction report (PTR) or executive-branch OGE Form 278-T that contains at least one trade whose bracket lower bound is >= minAmount. Each item carries the politician, filing link, filing delay, and every trade of the report sorted largest bracket first, with qualifyingTradeCount for how many clear the threshold. Polling contract: the returned nextCursor, sent back as `since`, returns each disclosure exactly once (for the same minAmount and kinds); nextCursor is returned even when items is empty, and hasMore true means more items are immediately available. Without `since` only disclosures that became complete in the last 48h are returned. A report is emitted only after no new row of it has arrived for a settle window (~8h), so items lag the filing by hours; a report that grows materially afterwards (+25 trades or +20%) is emitted once more with a higher `revision`, and `replacesPrevious: true` marks a report previously delivered under the same `id`. filingDelayDays (longest lag), isLateFiling (>45 days) and lateTradeCount exclude trades with transactionDateSuspect=true: a date lagging its own otherwise on-time report by about one year is a probable mistyped year upstream, listed as filed and counted in suspectDateCount, and its lag is not a measured filing delay. owner null means the filing did not state an owner ("Not stated"); it does not mean "Self". amountRange is the filed bracket; amountMin null means the bracket was not parsed (not $0), amountMax null means "Over $50,000,000" or unparsed, and ticker null means a non-equity asset.

kinds.description: Which disclosure kinds to include (default: both). 'congressional' = STOCK Act PTRs (Senate + House), 'executive' = OGE 278-T (Cabinet-level officials).

minAmount.description: USD threshold compared to each trade's bracket lower bound (default: 50001). A disclosure qualifies when ANY of its trades meets it.

since.description: Opaque cursor: the nextCursor from a previous call, verbatim. Omit only on the first call.

name: get_politician_disclosures
title: Get Politician Disclosures (Feed)
